title: `ward init` and project binding
description: Spec §7.1 and §11.2. Opaque project UUID in tracked .ward/project.json; binding to a canonical Git worktree root lives only in the encrypted vault. Unknown checkouts, copied IDs, nested repos, worktrees and moved paths never inherit a binding. Ward-managed CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md block preserves every other block.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T10: unknown project, copied project ID, nested repo, worktree, moved path and unregistered clone cannot silently inherit a binding
T22: repeated init preserves user content and peer blocks; malformed markers and escaping symlinks are conflicts, not overwrites

plan: 2. ADR 0005 (binding identity), docs index link, .lore/agents source lists (WCLI-25 gap).
3. Domain: identifiers, vault-state (projects+localBindings), project-manifest, managed-block; unit tests.
4. Application: ProjectFiles and RegistrationConsent ports, Ward block text, checkout inspection + registration + init use-case.
5. Adapters: git-boundary checkout locator with directory identity, contained atomic project-file writes, terminal consent.
6. CLI: init command, manifest entry, error catalog, composition-root wiring; update contract test for the new command.
7. Tests: T10 six non-inheritance cases, T22 block preservation and symlink conflicts, no-vault and declined paths.
8. bun run check + lore check, PR, squash merge, delete local branch, close WCLI-7 with PR and CI run evidence, report to orchestrator.
